transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I came in today because I just... I can’t seem to stop launching projects. It's like I get started and I'm drafting up new work plans, making these massive certification schedules, doing full home network upgrades, or just firing off messages to old contacts. 

It gets so intense that I just blow past normal limits. I don't really stop until my wife or my director at work has to actually step in and tell me to slow down.
During these periods, have you had experiences like hearing voices or becoming convinced of things that other people said weren’t true?

Yeah, actually. Um... during my most driven stretches, when I'm barely sleeping and just pushing those huge plans forward, I do experience some of that. 

It sounds strange, but I'll hear... like, actual comments in the server noise at work. Just voices in the hum of the machines. And I also start reading into things, like I become convinced there are hidden threats directed at me in regular work messages.
Have you ever heard those voices or felt those hidden threats when you were not in one of those high-energy, barely-sleeping periods?

Yeah, I have. Um... there have been several stretches where things were just calm, or even kind of flat. Like, for a few weeks at a time, I wouldn't be especially up, and I wasn't really down or depressed either. 

But even during those normal periods, I still believed that people's Teams statuses at work were actually coded warnings meant for me. And I would still hear those brief comments when no one else was in the room.
Have you ever had a period where you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yeah, I have. Um... there are definitely stretches where I just wake up feeling like a failed version of myself. It's just this heavy, flat feeling that lasts for weeks at a time. When it gets like that, it takes everything out of me. Like, even just answering my wife's normal, everyday questions feels like it's way too much to handle.
Have there been at least two weeks when you were hearing voices or believing those coded warnings while you were not in a high-energy or depressed episode?

Yeah, like I mentioned earlier, there have been times when my mood was just normal. I wasn't feeling depressed, and I wasn't full of energy either. Just... flat or calm, I guess. And yeah, those periods lasted for a few weeks at a time. Even then, I still believed those Teams statuses were warnings directed at me, and I still heard those comments when I was alone.
